tests.title: Landing page loads with hero content
tests.description: Verify the public landing page renders correctly with hero heading, subtitle, and CTA buttons
steps: Verify page title is 'AI Restaurant Copilot'
Verify Sign Up button is visible
tests.expected: Landing page renders with all hero content visible

tests.title: Login page renders
tests.description: Verify the login page renders email, password fields and submit button
steps: Verify Sign In button is visible
tests.expected: Login page renders with form elements

tests.title: Login redirects to dashboard
tests.description: Submitting any email and password redirects to /dashboard
tests.expected: User is redirected to /dashboard after login

tests.title: Signup page renders
tests.description: Verify the signup page renders with name, email, password fields
steps: Verify heading 'Create your account' is visible
Verify Create Account button is visible
tests.expected: Signup page renders with all form fields

tests.title: Signup redirects to dashboard
steps: Fill name field with Spice Garden
tests.expected: User is redirected to /dashboard after signup

tests.title: Dashboard renders KPI cards
tests.description: Verify dashboard shows all 4 KPI metric cards
steps: Verify 'Total Orders Today' card is visible
Verify 'Avg Order Value' card is visible
Verify 'Top Selling Item' card is visible
tests.expected: All 4 KPI cards with correct data are visible

tests.title: Dashboard chart: Orders Over Time renders
tests.description: Verify the line/area chart is rendered with axis labels
steps: Verify 'Orders Over Time' heading is visible
Verify chart area is rendered (SVG present)
tests.expected: Orders Over Time chart renders with time axis labels

tests.title: Dashboard sidebar navigation visible
tests.description: Verify the sidebar shows all navigation links
steps: Verify 'Dashboard' nav link is visible and active
Verify 'Voice Ordering' nav link is visible

tests.title: Orders page direct navigation renders table
tests.description: Directly navigating to /dashboard/orders renders the order table
steps: Verify table header 'Order ID' is visible
Verify order '#101' is visible in table
Verify order '#104' is visible in table
Verify status filter buttons are visible
tests.expected: Orders table renders with data on direct URL navigation

tests.title: Orders page: clicking order opens kitchen ticket
tests.description: Clicking an order row shows kitchen ticket side panel with upsell
steps: Verify 'AI Upsell Recommendation' card is visible
tests.expected: Kitchen ticket side panel appears with order details and AI upsell

tests.title: Orders page: status filter works
tests.description: Clicking status filter buttons filters the orders table
steps: Verify only Preparing orders are visible
Verify all orders are visible again
tests.expected: Status filter correctly shows/hides orders by status

tests.title: Voice Ordering page direct navigation renders
tests.description: Directly navigating to /dashboard/voice renders the voice ordering UI
steps: Verify microphone button area is visible
Verify 'Press to start voice ordering' text is visible
tests.expected: Voice ordering page renders on direct navigation

tests.title: Voice ordering demo flow works
tests.description: Pressing the mic button triggers demo flow with transcript and items
steps: Verify listening state is active (text changes)
Wait 4 seconds for demo to complete
Verify transcript box shows Hindi text
Verify 'Paneer Pizza' is in detected items
tests.expected: Demo voice flow completes showing detected items

tests.title: Analytics page direct navigation renders
tests.description: Directly navigating to /dashboard/analytics renders all charts and tables
steps: Verify 'Menu Profitability Matrix' heading is visible
tests.expected: Analytics page renders on direct navigation

tests.title: Analytics: scatter chart renders with data
tests.description: Verify the profitability scatter chart renders with SVG and dot elements
steps: Verify scatter chart SVG is present
Verify combo table shows 'Paneer Pizza' entry
tests.expected: Scatter chart and data tables render correctly

tests.title: Navbar: in-app navigation between all sections
tests.description: Clicking sidebar nav links correctly navigates between sections
tests.expected: All sidebar nav links navigate to correct routes

tests.title: Logout button returns to landing page
tests.expected: Logout button navigates to landing page

tests.title: Unknown route redirects to landing
tests.description: Navigating to an unknown route redirects to /
steps: Verify landing page hero is visible
tests.expected: Unknown routes redirect to landing page
